Build verdict follows documented free cluster provisioning and available scoped service accounts. It does not imply database CRUD is available through administration credentials.
Fresh official platform page confirms OAuth sign-in plus granular personal access tokens; PAT help corroborates user/resource scopes.

Opened official help states all-plan availability. Caveat worth adding to production_gate: enterprise admins can restrict/allowlist third-party MCP integrations; this does not change the free personal-workspace issuance path.

Opened help confirms vendor MCP, OAuth/PAT setup paths, permissions, all-plan access and inherited API quotas.
Build verdict is supported for scoped self-serve PAT access across plans. Existing enterprise third-party restrictions may need admin action; it is not a universal paid-plan gate.
